introHtml: Custom jackets with wheels combine the comfort of a jacket with the convenience of built-in luggage. These hybrid outerwear pieces let your team or clients travel hands-free, keeping essentials close while representing your brand. Ideal for corporate travel gifts or event staff, they offer practical utility that standard jackets can't match. Choose from popular decoration methods like embroidery or screen printing to showcase your logo prominently.
